title: Error from width truncation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on the Boolean cube $\{\pm1\}^n$, with each term a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates. For every $\varepsilon>0$, the fraction of inputs on which $\varphi$ differs from the formula obtained by retaining only terms of width at most $\lceil\log_2(\operatorname{size}(\varphi)/\varepsilon)\rceil$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on the Boolean cube of dimension n
Each term has distinct literal coordinates
